title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management connector moves to certificate-based authentication
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents roles that can create and manage the Entra app registration, contrary to the briefing's statement that these roles are not stated. The existing connector installation guidance also requires the installing account to be allowed to protect content when onboarding controls are configured; that qualification is missing.
